settings.threeFingerSwipeDesc: Pan the canvas with a three-finger horizontal swipe
settings.preventSleep: Prevent sleep while tasks are running

settings.sandboxDesc: New conversations start outside the sandbox, free to read and write beyond the workspace; turn it on to keep them inside the boundary.

settings.sandboxWebHint: Pre-approves web search and browser tools.

usageReport.emptyHint: Once you hold a conversation, token spend, request counts and daily activity show up here.

usageReport.detailsDesc: {{count}} calls in this window, newest first, with the cost of each.
usageReport.source: Read from {{scanned}} session files under {{path}}, on this Mac only — nothing is uploaded.
usageReport.note: Counting rule: the per-call delta recorded in each session, so a compacted context does not shrink the total. Cache hit rate = cached reads ÷ input.
usageReport.costInfo: Estimated from each vendor's official standard API pricing: CNY-quoted models are summed directly, USD-quoted models are converted at the rate below. Only priced models are counted.
usageReport.priceConfigDesc: Manage the models you want to count, grouped by vendor: add vendors and models, pick a currency (CNY or USD), and give time-of-day models their peak/off-peak rates. The headline amount is always shown in CNY. Built in: 8 reference vendors / 25 flagship models, plus 3 Xiaomi MiMo models.
usageReport.priceUnit: Unit price per 1M tokens, in each model's own currency
usageReport.vendorUrlPlaceholder: This vendor's official pricing page URL (HTML pages work too)
usageReport.vendorRuleHint: Regex needs named groups model / input / cached (optional) / output; prices are parsed per 1M tokens. Official pages are HTML, so re-test with "Update" after any page redesign.
usageReport.vendorOpenRouter: OpenRouter JSON source (vendor prefix: {{prefix}}); per-token prices are scaled to per-1M automatically.
usageReport.vendorUrlEmpty: Enter this vendor's pricing page URL first
usageReport.vendorNoMatch: The rule matched {{count}} models, but none are in your current list (check the model ids or rule)
usageReport.priceHint: Built-in prices are a hand-checked snapshot of each vendor's official page on 2026-11-03 (8 reference vendors / 25 flagship models, plus 3 Xiaomi MiMo models): DeepSeek has peak and off-peak rates; OpenAI, Claude and xAI are USD standard short-context rates; Qwen, Kimi, 智谱, MiniMax and Xiaomi are CNY rates. Long-context, cache-write and explicit-cache conditions are noted under each model id; the vendor console is authoritative.
usageReport.costNote: Note: this is an estimate only. Your actual bill is whatever each vendor charges; models without a configured price are excluded from the amount.
usageReport.priceTimezoneHint: (8 = Beijing; peak/off-peak windows use this clock)

defaultModel.title: Default chat model
defaultModel.routerDesc: The app's own forwarding layer. Every model request passes through it; the app injects it into the engine at launch, so it needs no configuration here and offers none.
defaultModel.routerNote: It is not a vendor, so it never appears in the model lists below. If it breaks, relaunching the app restores it.
defaultModel.routerEnterprise: Models from your ALwith company account (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, for example) appear in the list below once you sign in. Until then only locally available models are shown.
defaultModel.description: The model and effort new conversations start on; each chat can still change them at any time.
defaultModel.catalogUnavailable: The engine has not returned its GPT catalog (the online refresh timed out). GPT models are hidden for now so a withdrawn one cannot be picked; they return as soon as the catalog does.
defaultModel.candidatesNote: Candidates come from the models enabled under Providers.
defaultModel.modelDescription: The model a new conversation starts on — the integrated GPT or any configured provider.
defaultModel.effortDescription: Used only when the model's row in Available models leaves Effort unset; a model that publishes its own default wins.
defaultModel.effortUnavailable: This model publishes no effort catalog; new conversations use its own default.

effortLevels.none: Thinking off - answers straight away, fastest
effortLevels.high: Deeper reasoning, steadier on hard tasks
effortLevels.max: Deepest reasoning - for the hardest problems

defaultModel.rules:
Priority: a model picked inside a chat > these defaults > auto.
Model on Auto: new chats use the engine's default model. Effort on Auto: follows the model family's declared default.
"Restore auto" clears both defaults and returns to auto.
defaultModel.fastModeUnavailable: Fast mode is available for GPT models only
defaultModel.fastModeOnHint: Fast mode is on; GPT models only
defaultModel.fastModeOffHint: Turn on fast mode; GPT models only
defaultModel.divisionDescription: The planner/worker pair a new split starts from; each chat's division menu can still override it.

versionGuard.title: Stop old versions overwriting local files
versionGuard.desc: Local only: remembers a fingerprint of each Drive file's content. If sync ever writes back content this machine has already seen and which is not the newest (typically another device uploading an old copy), it restores the local shadow copy and tells you. A file you saved yourself in the last 15 seconds is never treated as a rollback. Off restores the plain Drive behaviour: no fingerprints, no shadow copies.
versionGuard.versionGuardRestored: Blocked an old-version overwrite: {{name}} was restored to the newest local content

error.providerKeyRejected: That API key was rejected (HTTP 401). Copy it again — no spaces, line breaks or non-ASCII punctuation.

error.providerRateLimited: Too many requests, or the quota is used up (HTTP 429). Try again later.

error.providerHttpError: The endpoint returned HTTP {{status}}, so the model list could not be read.
error.driveNotAttached: No compatible Drive service is attached. Connect Drive in Settings and try again.
error.driveUnavailable: The Drive service is unavailable. Reconnect and try again.
error.driveShortcutBroken: This Drive shortcut cannot be opened — it may be damaged, loop back to itself, or nest too deeply. Delete it and create a new one.
error.driveShortcutNoDestination: The file this Drive shortcut points to is gone from both the local copy and the web.
error.driveLinkUnavailable: This Drive link opens neither locally nor on the web; the file may have been deleted or moved.
error.driveStillLoading: Drive settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.
error.driveConfigChanged: The Drive configuration changed while this session was being prepared. Try again.
error.driveCredentialsUnavailable: Drive credentials are missing. Sign in to Drive again in settings.
error.driveProjectUnavailable: This Drive project is unavailable — it may not be indexed any more, or it was removed.
error.driveWebUnavailable: Drive did not provide a web address, so this file can only be opened locally.
error.driveEntryGone: The selected Drive entry is no longer there — it may have been deleted or moved.
error.driveInvalidResponse: Drive returned data this build does not understand (likely a version mismatch). Retry; if it persists, restart the app.
error.requestCanceled: The request timed out and was cancelled — most likely the account service (api.alwith.ai) is unreachable, which happens outside the company network. Retry on that network.
error.chatWindowNoResponse: The chat window did not respond. Try again.
error.chatWindowInitFailed: The chat window failed to start. Try again.
error.chatWindowNotReady: The chat window is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
error.chatWindowInvalid: The chat window is in an unexpected state. Try again.
error.providerMismatch: This chat belongs to {{from}}, but the engine runs {{to}}. This chat cannot change vendors — start a new one.
error.providerPinned: This chat was created by an older version and is still pinned to {{provider}}, so it cannot switch vendors. A new chat switches freely.
error.providerMissing: This chat was created with {{provider}}, which is no longer configured. Restore that provider to open it.
error.routerProviderMissing: The built-in router (alwith) is missing from ~/.codex/config.toml, so the engine cannot start. Relaunching the app restores it; if that still fails, check the last line of adapter-provider.log under ~/Library/Logs/ai.alwith.u/.
error.configTomlInvalid: The engine cannot read ~/.codex/config.toml — usually the same key written twice. Relaunching the app clears duplicate built-in router keys; if it persists, open the file and delete the repeated line. The log is adapter-provider.log under ~/Library/Logs/ai.alwith.u/.
error.providerSwitchFailed: Changing the provider failed and this chat was closed. Start a new chat to continue.
error.providerSwitchFailedDetail: Changing the provider failed ({{detail}}). Start a new chat to continue.
error.fileNotFound: File not found: the path or resource is missing (HTTP 404).
error.networkUnreachable: Could not reach the network. Check the connection and try again.
error.providerUnreachable: Could not connect to the model service. Check your network, proxy, or VPN, then retry.
error.providerConnectionTimedOut: Connecting to the model service timed out. Retry later or switch models.
error.providerRequestFailed: The request to the model service failed. Retry later or switch models.
error.notSignedIn: You are not signed in yet. Sign in with your ALwith account first.
error.codexNotSignedIn: Not signed in to Codex — sign in to ChatGPT first, then try again.
error.sessionGone: The engine cannot find this chat ({{id}}): it may have been deleted, or it was never saved before the engine restarted.
error.engineCrashLoop: The Codex engine crashed {{count}} times in {{minutes}} min (last exit code {{code}}), so it stopped restarting. Try again in about {{seconds}} s, or restart the app.
error.engineCrashLoopShort: The Codex engine crashed {{count}} times in {{minutes}} min, so it stopped restarting.
error.engineRestarted: The engine is switching vendors and this request was interrupted. Try again.
error.engineInitTimeout: The engine took too long to start ({{seconds}}). Try again.
error.activeWriter: This chat is in use by another Codex client (Codex App / CLI / IDE extension). Close it there first.
error.fileChangedWhileOpening: The file changed after you opened it — common in cloud-synced folders. Reopen it and try again.
error.fileReadOnlyOrLocked: The file is read-only, or another app or person is editing it. Check its permissions, or wait for the cloud sync to finish.
error.sessionBusy: This chat is still running. Try again when the turn finishes.
error.runtimeDown: The local runtime is not running. Reconnect to continue.
error.connectionReplaced: The window connection was replaced. Try again.
error.historyUnreplayable: This chat's history cannot be replayed on the current model (it was created by another vendor or model). Start a new chat.
error.gatewayModel: This endpoint does not serve “{{model}}”; it only offers {{served}}. Pick another model.
error.sessionInUse: Another Codex client (the Codex app, the CLI or an IDE extension) is using this session. Close it there, then try again.
error.signInIncomplete: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.
error.engineUnavailable: The conversation service is unavailable right now. Try again.
error.engineInternal: Something went wrong inside the conversation service. Try again.
error.usageLimit: You have reached the usage limit. Try again later.
error.contextLimit: The conversation no longer fits the model's context window. Start a new chat or clear the context.
error.streamInterrupted: The connection to the model was interrupted. Try again.
error.providerEndpointNotFound: The provider returned 404: the endpoint does not exist. A base URL that only supports Chat Completions is the usual cause. Set that provider's Base URL to its Responses API endpoint in Settings → Models.
error.providerChangedElsewhere: These settings were updated by another save (for example a model switch in this same card). Saving was retried and still missed. Refresh the model list, then save again.
error.streamTimedOut: The upstream went quiet for too long, so the connection was closed. Retry or switch models.
error.backgroundTimeout: A background service (Drive / model catalog) timed out. The current chat is unaffected; it will retry shortly.
error.timeout: The request timed out. Try again.
error.network: The network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.authRequired: Sign in to ChatGPT to continue.
error.modelUnavailable: The model {{model}} is not available right now. Pick another model.
error.modelUnavailableGeneric: That model is not available right now. Pick another model.
error.modelNoGateway: The model {{model}} has no provider behind it, so this chat could not switch. Pick the model again from the list.
error.gatewayMissing: The provider {{gateway}} is not configured. Add it in Settings → Models.
error.modelUnsupported: This chat is pinned to {{model}}, which the engine no longer accepts. Pick another model and send again.
error.chatgptAtCapacity: The ChatGPT backend is at capacity. Every GPT model on this account queues together, so switching to another GPT model usually will not help — wait a bit or switch to another vendor's model.
error.nativeSignInRequired: ChatGPT sign-in is required. Every GPT model shares one account credential, so switching models will not help — sign in from the account menu first.
error.modelAtCapacity: This model is at capacity right now. Pick another model in the selector below and send again.
error.invalidEffort: This model does not accept '{{value}}' as a reasoning level. Pick another level under Settings → Default model → Effort.
error.authenticationRequired: Your ChatGPT sign-in has expired. Sign in again from the account menu, then continue.
error.tokenRefreshFailed: Your sign-in could not be renewed automatically. Sign out and sign in to ChatGPT again.
error.signInTokenRejected: The ChatGPT backend rejected your sign-in token. Sign out and sign in again.
error.unknownSettingKey: This setting is not recognised, so the change was not saved. Restart the app and try again.
error.invalidSetting: Setting {{key}} has an invalid value, so the change was not saved.
error.quotaExceeded: Your plan's quota is used up (account-level — switching GPT models will not help). Check your plan and billing details.
error.runtimeRequestFailed: The conversation service rejected this request. Try again.
